transcription: « On this day, the twenty-sixth of November, in the Year of Our Lord one thousand eight hundred and seventy-three, Before me the undersigned Notary Public […] residing in the parish of St Romuald, county of Lévis, Personally came and appeared Michael McAneeny, joiner, of the said parish, Who did, and by these presents doth demise and lease unto William Thomas Dee, of the same place, laborer, who hereby accepts for himself, his heirs, executors, curators and administrators, that is to say : A certain wooden house, one story high, lying & situated on the north level of public road, in the same parish, adjoining to the east side to the lessor & to the west by McKenzie […] commence to run and to be computed from the first of December and fully to be completed and ended on the first day of May which will be in the year of our Lord one thousand eight hundred and seventy-four […] The present lease is further made for and in consideration of the sum of twenty-five dollars for the whole of its duration, which the said lessee doth bind and oblige himself to pay unto the lessor or to his order, in good current money, by five equal & monthly payments of five dollars each, to the entire payment of the said sum. […] Thus done and passed at the aforesaid parish of St Romuald, in the office of the said Notary, on the day and year above written, under the number ten [?] of the original deeds of said notary, and the parties have signed their names with us Notary after reading duly made according to law. One hundred & two words struck out are null. Two marginal notes approved good. » Signatures : « M. McAneeny », « W. T. Dee », « E. H. Tremblay N.P. »
